component.name: Wolfscribe Local
component.summary: Offline novel writing for your own machine

description.p: Wolfscribe Local is a complete novel-writing workspace that runs entirely on your own computer. Manuscripts, chapters, character cast, reference images, autosave and version history stay on your drive, and the app works with no internet connection at all.

It is part of the Wolf Creative Suite. With a Wolf account you can optionally back your manuscripts up to WolfScribe Cloud, sealed on your computer before upload. Nothing leaves your machine until you switch that on.

ul.li: Autosave with version history, plus a 30-day Trash for manuscripts, characters and references
Character and reference panels with images
Offline spellcheck in Canadian, UK and US English, French (incl. Canadian), Spanish, German and Dutch
Import and export DOCX, PDF, EPUB and plain text; encrypted backup files
Optional passphrase that encrypts your writing on this computer

description.p: No tracking, no ads, and no built-in AI models or AI writing features.

ul.li: Full library backups now include every manuscript, character image and reference image
Restoring a backup into an empty library is a single click
Unsaved edits are written to disk before backups and on close
